strategies.name: POV
strategies.sourceXml:
<Strategy name="POV" version="1" wireValue="POV" uiRep="POV" providerID="DEMO" xmlns="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Core">
    <Parameter name="TargetPercentage" xsi:type="Percentage_t" fixTag="7700" use="optional" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" />
    <Parameter name="Aggression" xsi:type="String_t" fixTag="7702" use="optional" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
      <EnumPair enumID="PASSIVE" wireValue="PASSIVE" />
      <EnumPair enumID="NEUTRAL" wireValue="NEUTRAL" />
      <EnumPair enumID="AGGRESSIVE" wireValue="AGGRESSIVE" />
    </Parameter>
    <lay:StrategyLayout xmlns:lay="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Layout">
      <lay:StrategyPanel title="POV Parameters" orientation="VERTICAL" collapsible="false" border="Line">
        <lay:Control ID="c_TargetPercentage" xsi:type="lay:TextField_t" parameterRef="TargetPercentage" label="Target %" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
          <flow:StateRule enabled="false" xmlns:flow="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Flow">
            <val:Edit field="c_Aggression" operator="EQ" value="PASSIVE" xmlns:val="http://www.fixprotocol.org/FIXatdl-1-1/Validation" />
          </flow:StateRule>
        </lay:Control>
        <lay:Control ID="c_Aggression" xsi:type="lay:DropDownList_t" parameterRef="Aggression" label="Aggression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
          <lay:ListItem uiRep="Passive" enumID="PASSIVE" />
          <lay:ListItem uiRep="Neutral" enumID="NEUTRAL" />
          <lay:ListItem uiRep="Aggressive" enumID="AGGRESSIVE" />
        </lay:Control>
      </lay:StrategyPanel>
    </lay:StrategyLayout>
  </Strategy>
